photos.title: Oceanfront towers in Myrtle Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: A row of oceanfront high-rise and mid-rise buildings in Myrtle Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: flat roofs with rooftop boxes, stacked balconies on every floor, pools and umbrellas behind the dunes, the beach and surf in front, parking lots and trees behind. People on the beach are too small to recognize.
photos.caption: Oceanfront towers in Myrtle Beach, seen from a plane over the ocean in 2011.
photos.alt: A row of oceanfront towers in Myrtle Beach with flat roofs, stacked balconies and pools behind the dunes, seen from a plane over the ocean
photos.author: U.S. Geological Survey
photos.credit: Photo: U.S. Geological Survey, public domain. Credit not required; give it anyway.
photos.provenance: U.S. government photo: USGS baseline coastal oblique aerial survey 11CCH03 (Ponte Vedra, Florida, to the South Carolina/North Carolina border), flown 2011-08-24, photographer Karen L.M. Morgan (USGS). Frame 2011_0824_180052d.jpg from https://coastal.er.usgs.gov/data-release/doi-F7N877XX/data/11CCH03_0824_180000.zip; aircraft position 33.699958 N, 78.862068 W (11CCH03-Photolocations.csv; the position of the plane, not of the buildings). Data release: Morgan, K.L.M., 2017, https://doi.org/10.5066/F7N877XX. The same release as the photos on /hoa/special-assessments/ and /sell/out-of-state-buyers/ (different frames).

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer on 2026-11-01. The frame shows oceanfront towers with flat roofs and stacked balconies; it does not show whether each building is a condo or a hotel, so the caption says 'oceanfront towers', names no building, and says only that roofs and balconies like these are parts a condo reserve fund saves for. No sign or name is legible at page size. Reused on /buyers/va-loans/ (2026-11-02, looked at full size again): the caption there says these are oceanfront towers, names no building, and says only how few oceanfront resort buildings in our directory have an accepted VA record. Reused on /invest/condotel-financing/ (2026-11-10): the caption says these are oceanfront condo and resort towers with pools behind the dunes, names no building, and makes no claim about which of them is run as a hotel.

photos.title: Coquina Harbour and Lightkeepers Village slips from above, NAIP aerial, April 2023
photos.what: One long marina basin off the Intracoastal Waterway in Little River from straight above on April 10, 2023, full of boats in rows of slips: Coquina Harbour's slips in its upper part, Lightkeepers Village's near its mouth. Condo buildings line both sides, US 17 crosses the top left corner, a golf course is at the upper right, and the wide waterway and marsh are across the bottom. Labels: US 17, Coquina Harbour, Lightkeepers Village, Intracoastal Waterway.
photos.caption: Coquina Harbour and Lightkeepers Village share one basin between US 17 and the waterway.
photos.alt: A marina basin full of boats off the Intracoastal Waterway, from above, with Coquina Harbour labelled at its upper end, Lightkeepers Village near its mouth, US 17 at the top left and a golf course at the upper right

place.sublocation: Coquina Harbour and Lightkeepers Village, on the Intracoastal Waterway
